description: Test the json_ (not jsonb_) variant of json_array_elements in select-list position, using a native json column
name: json_array_elements_select_list
query_sql:
-- @name GetPayloadItemsSelectList
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, json_array_elements(payload->'items') AS item FROM payloads
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE payloads (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, payload JSON NOT NULL);
